mapper.select: select r.id, r.statement_id, r.catalog_names, r.database_names, r.table_names, r.column_names, b.bundle_id, b.scope_code, b.group_ids, sc.name as scope_name, sc.plugin_type as plugin_type, sc.ranger_service_name as ranger_service_name, sc.enabled as scope_enabled from t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement_resource r join t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement b on b.id = r.statement_id left join t_r_data_perm_scope sc on sc.code = b.scope_code where b.bundle_id in #{rid} order by b.id asc, r.id asc

select r.id, r.statement_id, r.catalog_names, r.database_names, r.table_names, r.column_names, b.bundle_id, b.scope_code, b.group_ids, sc.name as scope_name, sc.plugin_type as plugin_type, sc.ranger_service_name as ranger_service_name, sc.enabled as scope_enabled from t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement_resource r join t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement b on b.id = r.statement_id left join t_r_data_perm_scope sc on sc.code = b.scope_code where b.id in #{bid} order by b.id asc, r.id asc

select b.scope_code as scopeCode, sc.name as scopeName, b.group_ids as groupIds, c.v as catalogName, d.v as databaseName, t.v as tableName, col.v as columnName from t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement_resource r join t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement b on b.id = r.statement_id left join t_r_data_perm_scope sc on sc.code = b.scope_code join json_table(if(json_length(r.catalog_names) = 0, cast('[null]' as json), r.catalog_names), '$[*]' columns(v varchar(512) path '$')) c join json_table(if(json_length(r.database_names) = 0, cast('[null]' as json), r.database_names), '$[*]' columns(v varchar(512) path '$')) d join json_table(if(json_length(r.table_names) = 0, cast('[null]' as json), r.table_names), '$[*]' columns(v varchar(512) path '$')) t join json_table(if(json_length(r.column_names) = 0, cast('[null]' as json), r.column_names), '$[*]' columns(v varchar(512) path '$')) col where b.bundle_id = #{bundleId} order by b.id asc, r.id asc, c.v asc, d.v asc, t.v asc, col.v asc

select coalesce(sum( greatest(json_length(r.catalog_names), 1) * greatest(json_length(r.database_names), 1) * greatest(json_length(r.table_names), 1) * greatest(json_length(r.column_names), 1)), 0) from t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement_resource r join t_r_data_perm_bundle_statement b on b.id = r.statement_id where b.bundle_id = #{bundleId}
